Frequently Asked Questions

Questions, answered.

Everything you need to know about the scholarship, the certificate fee, the tracks, and what happens after you apply and pay.

ProTech Rise Academy is a scholarship-driven online tech academy for learners across Africa. We run structured, cohort-based programs with live classes, so you build real, job-ready skills alongside a community of peers, not just a self-paced video library.

Anyone interested in building practical tech skills. All 13 tracks are beginner-friendly. You need basic computer literacy, a device, and internet access.

Data Analytics, Frontend Development, Backend Development, Cloud Computing, Cybersecurity, Product Management, Project Management, Virtual Assistant, Mobile Development, AI Prompt Engineering, AI Automation, Digital Marketing, and Product Design — 13 tracks in total.

The Cohort 2 Tech Bootcamp has a tuition fee of {{TUITION_FEE}}. With our {{SCHOLARSHIP_PERCENT}}% scholarship you pay {{ONBOARDING_FEE}} instead, as a one-time certificate fee. Fill in the application, pay, and your spot is confirmed.

No. The {{ONBOARDING_FEE}} certificate fee is non-refundable once paid, including if you withdraw, miss the start or do not complete the bootcamp (in which case no certificate is issued). The only exception is excess payment: if you pay more than the amount due, such as being charged twice, we refund the excess. Read the full refund policy.

It secures your spot in Cohort 2 and covers your certificate, which is issued when you successfully complete the bootcamp. You pay it now; the certificate comes at the end.

After you successfully complete the Cohort 2 Tech Bootcamp. Paying the fee does not guarantee a certificate by itself; completing the programme does.

Once your payment is confirmed you complete your onboarding in the student portal. After that you get access to your personalised LMS dashboard. Already onboarded? Use LMS in the menu at the top of any page to sign in.

Confirmation can take a few minutes. Check your email for the receipt, then open your status page. If it still shows payment pending after an hour, email hello@protechrise.com with your payment reference. Please do not pay twice.

You fill in one short form, choose your track, accept the terms and pay the {{ONBOARDING_FEE}} certificate fee. Your Cohort 2 spot is confirmed as soon as payment clears, and we email your receipt and next steps. If you start the form but do not pay, use the same email on the application page and we take you straight back to payment.

You can submit one application per email address for each cohort. If you need to change your preferred track after applying, email us at hello@protechrise.com and we'll help.

Applications for Cohort 2 are open now. Apply and pay to secure your spot.

Yes, fully live online, 6PM/7:30PM WAT. Sessions are recorded too. Designed to fit around a full-time job or studies.

You'll get a confirmation email as soon as you apply, and another whenever your application status changes. You can also check your status any time — enter your email and we'll send you a link.

You leave with a portfolio, certificate, and active career support: interview coaching, employer introductions, and ongoing support until you sign your first offer.

Yes, every graduate receives a ProTech Rise Academy certificate. More importantly, you'll have a real portfolio of work to show employers.

Email us any time at hello@protechrise.com. If you're not ready to apply yet, join the waitlist at protechrise.com and we'll keep you updated.
